description: This file defines a class 'Smarty_Internal_Method_GetConfigVars' that implements a method to retrieve configuration variables within the Smarty template engine. It includes a method 'getConfigVars' that fetches a specific configuration variable or all variables, optionally searching parent templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_GetConfigVars
classes.description: A class providing functionality to retrieve configuration variables within the Smarty template engine.

methods.name: getConfigVars
methods.description: Retrieves a single configuration variable by name or all configuration variables, optionally searching parent templates.
